subject: Hosted API: Bridge top-up & rate safeguard for Q3 renewal
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena@brightcart.com>
Cc: Darren Cole <darren.cole@brightcart.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Mar 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API: Bridge top-up & rate safeguard for Q3 renewal

Hi Elena / Darren,

Thanks again for the conversation last week. As BrightCart heads into peak preparations for Q3 we discussed a conservative path to avoid throttling spikes while you finish your traffic re-routing: a temporary bridge top-up (one-time committed uplift for 60 days) paired with a soft-rate safeguard that prevents sudden overage throttles while keeping unit economics predictable.

Proposed high-level: 
- Increase hosted monthly commit from 4.5M tokens to 7.0M tokens for a 60-day top-up window (effective Apr 1).
- Apply a temporary reduced overage rate band for the first 30 days post-roll (20% discount on standard overage).
- Include a canary policy: requests over 95th percentile can be routed to a compatible quantized variant for 2 weeks to stabilize latency.

I attached a short amendment draft and a one-page bridge_terms.pdf that lays out trigger dates and billing flow. If this looks reasonable I can route the amendment to procurement and push a DocuSign for signatures; if you prefer, we can split the top-up into two month-to-month increments.

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm the uplift size & go-live date (we suggested Apr 1 to align with your campaign).
2) I send final amendment and DocuSign.
3) Operations schedules the canary and pre-warms cache.

Would love confirmation by next Tue (Mar 16) so we can ensure capacity reservations.

Cheers,
Marcus Lin
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
Attachments: bridge_terms.pdf (PDF, 1 page), redwood-commit-amendment.docx (DOCX, 3 pages)

From: Elena Park <elena@brightcart.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Cc: Darren Cole <darren.cole@brightcart.com>, procurement@brightcart.com
Date: Tue, 09 Mar 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API: Bridge top-up & rate safeguard for Q3 renewal

Thanks Marcus  quick read looks good. A few questions before I loop procurement: 
- Can you confirm whether the discounted overage applies only to hosted and not Dedicated? We only have hosted here so should be fine but want clarity.
- How will the canary routing affect existing latency SLAs for the checkout path? We need checkout latency to stay within 220ms p50.

Procurement: we need the standard PO terms and a line item showing the one-time credit and the monthly commit adjustment for April/May.

If this is straightforward we can sign within 48 hours.

Elena
Elena Park
Head of Platform Engineering, BrightCart

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena@brightcart.com>, Darren Cole <darren.cole@brightcart.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 14:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API: Bridge top-up & rate safeguard for Q3 renewal

Elena  thanks, good questions. Quick answers: 
- Discounted overage: this amendment only touches Hosted API SKU; Dedicated pools are unaffected (we'll call that out explicitly in section 2.1).
- Canary routing: the plan routes <=5% of peak traffic to a quantized variant during the 2-week canary only. Based on our baseline tests this keeps p50 under 220ms for checkout; we’ll also set a rollback threshold at p99 > 350ms. Ops will monitor in real-time and abort if thresholds trip.

I’ve updated the amendment doc (attached) to call out the billing line items for the two-month uplift and the one-time bridge credit. I’m going to send this to procurement with a DocuSign link; Vanessa, Karthik — can you confirm the discounted overage SKU code (and the accounting GL for the one-time credit) so we can populate the PO line?

Attachment: redwood-commit-amendment.docx (updated)

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 09:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Hosted API: Bridge top-up & rate safeguard for Q3 renewal

Marcus  forwarding to confirm GL/accounting and SKU mapping.

Marcus wrote: 
> I’ve updated the amendment doc (attached) to call out the billing line items for the two-month uplift and the one-time bridge credit. I’m going to send this to procurement with a DocuSign link; Vanessa, Karthik — can you confirm the discounted overage SKU code (and the accounting GL for the one-time credit) so we can populate the PO line?

Karthik — use SKU HOST-OVR-TS20 for the temporary overage band and bill to GL 63012 (Partner Credits). The one-time bridge credit should be entered as line item HOST-TOPUP-1x and mapped to GL 63015 (Promo Credits). I’ll pre-fill the DocuSign with those line items before sending.

I’ll queue the DocuSign for E-sign tomorrow morning.

Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Revenue Operations Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena@brightcart.com>, procurement@brightcart.com
Cc: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Final: DocuSign complete  bridge top-up effective Apr 1

Hi Elena / Procurement,

Thanks  confirming DocuSign completed this morning. Highlights: 
- Commit uplift: Hosted monthly commit increased to 7.0M tokens for Apr & May (SKUs: HOST-COMMIT-7M).
- One-time bridge credit recorded as HOST-TOPUP-1x (GL 63015).
- Discounted overage SKU HOST-OVR-TS20 active Apr 130 (20% discount).
- Canary policy scheduled: Apr 1  Apr 14, 5% quantized routing, rollback if p99 > 350ms.

Operations will pre-warm KV caches on Mar 31 and begin capacity reservations tonight. I’ve linked the HubSpot deal and the DocuSign envelope for your records: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/7421/RED-BC-2027-0142 and https://www.docusign.com/driver?envelopeId=5a3c2efb

If you need a short ops runbook for your SREs (cache keys, feature flags to toggle canary), I can send that over all other wise we’ll proceed with the Apr 1 activation.

Appreciate the quick turnaround  looking forward to seeing the campaign stabilize.

Warmly,
Marcus Lin
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
Attachments: bridge_terms.pdf (final)
